capabilities: Create, edit, complete, move, and copy daily tasks between dates
Schedule recurring routines with per-occurrence move, edit, complete, and skip overrides
Organize tasks with categories and groups without query syntax
Run monthly reviews of completed tasks and activity
Save recovery snapshots and automatic safety backups in the vault
extras: Detailed usage instructions live in an in-app User Guide rather than the README; the author warns updates may be infrequent and recommends backing up vault data before updates or custom modifications; no network requests or telemetry.
motivation: The author originally built it for personal day-to-day planning and later shared it publicly as-is.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in planner interface, so users assemble daily task management from separate notes, queries, and dashboards.
